name: Visitor Traffic Real Time Statistics
author: wp-buy

sections.description:
Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics for WordPress

Unlock powerful insights into your website traffic with Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics, the WordPress plugin for tracking visitors, page views, countries, browsers and more — all in one intuitive dashboard.

With real-time data and easy-to-use shortcodes, you’ll get a complete picture of your site’s performance without the complexity. Whether you’re a blogger, business owner, or marketer, this plugin gives you the tools to understand your audience better and make smarter decisions.

Why Choose Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics?

  • Real-Time Visitor Tracking: See how many people are on your site right now and how your traffic changes through the day.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard: All your key insights are displayed on a single, easy-to-navigate dashboard.
  • Comprehensive Analytics: Track visitors by country, browser, referrer, page and hour of the day.
  • Shortcode Integration: Display visitor stats anywhere on your site with simple shortcodes.
  • SEO Insights: See which search engines send visitors, the pages they land on, and what visitors search for on your site.
  • Accurate Numbers: Bots and crawlers are filtered out, and time on site only counts while the visitor is actually reading.

Available Shortcodes (Simple & Flexible)

Add these shortcodes to any post, page, or widget to showcase your traffic stats:

  • [ahc_stats_widget] – Display a site-wide statistics widget on the front end.
  • [ahc_stats_widget title="Your Title" fontsize="16" display_today_visitors=true display_total_visitors=true] – Customize the widget with your own parameters.
  • [ahc_today_visitors] – Display today’s visitors.
  • [ahc_today_visits] – Display today’s page views.
  • [ahc_total_visitors] – Show your all-time visitor count.
  • [ahc_total_visits] – Display total page views.
  • [ahc_yesterday_total_visitors] and [ahc_yesterday_total_visits] – Display yesterday’s visitors and page views.

Free Version Features:

  • Live count of visitors online and today’s traffic compared with yesterday.
  • Traffic report with daily and monthly trends.
  • Visitors by country on an interactive world map.
  • Browsers, search engines, top referring sites and top pages.
  • Visits by hour of the day.
  • Search traffic: the pages search visitors land on and your site’s own search terms.
  • Shortcodes and a widget to display key stats on your site.

Upgrade to Pro for Even More Power!

Take your analytics to the next level with Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics Pro:

  • Live Visitors: See who is online right now, where they are and which page they are reading.
  • Full Traffic Sources: Every source (direct, search, social and referrals) with complete history.
  • Country Insights: Visits, visitors and trends for every country, with unlimited history.
  • Visitor Journeys: Follow the path each visitor takes through your pages.
  • Per-Page Statistics: Views, visitors and time on page for every post and page.
  • Visit Duration: See how long each visitor really stays.
  • Multisite Support: Track traffic across multiple sites in one place.

Who Can Benefit?

  • Bloggers who want to track reader engagement.
  • E-commerce store owners looking to understand customer behavior.
  • Marketers seeking to optimize SEO strategies.
  • Website administrators who need detailed traffic analysis.

Get Started Today!

Install the plugin now to gain valuable insights into your site traffic and grow your online presence.

Go PRO Now to unlock all premium features and maximize your analytics potential!

Visit Our Support Center for any assistance.

Your website is getting visitors. Don’t miss out on the insights that can help your business grow.

sections.faq:
How do I set up this plugin?

  1. Download the package.
  2. Upload it from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or extract the .zip file into the wp-content/plugins/ folder.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page.

Or go to your website dashboard > Plugins > Add New, search for “Visitor Traffic Real Time Statistics”, then install and activate it.

Notes:
* The plugin uses the timezone from Settings > General. You can choose a different one on the plugin’s Settings page.
* If you use a caching plugin, clear your website cache after activating.

How do I set up the PRO version of this plugin?

  1. Purchase your license on our website here.
  2. Check your email (inbox and junk folder) for the download link of the plugin’s .zip file.
  3. Open your website dashboard > Plugins > Add New and upload the .zip file.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open “Visitor Traffic Pro” from your dashboard menu.

Notes:
* Check the timezone on the plugin’s Settings page.
* If you use a caching plugin, clear your website cache after activating.

Shortcodes for summary statistics

You can use the following shortcodes:

*[ahc_stats_widget] adds a box with the site statistics
*[ahc_stats_widget title=”” fontsize=”16″ fonttype=”” display_today_visitors=true display_today_pageviwes=true display_total_visitors=true display_total_pageviwes=true] the same box with custom options

*[ahc_today_visitors] shows today’s visitors
*[ahc_today_visits] shows today’s page views
*[ahc_total_visitors] shows total visitors
*[ahc_total_visits] shows total page views

*[ahc_yesterday_total_visitors] shows yesterday’s visitors
*[ahc_yesterday_total_visits] shows yesterday’s page views

Is it GDPR compliant?

All data is stored locally in your WordPress database, so you don’t need a data processing agreement with an external company.

Does this plugin support Multisite?

The plugin doesn’t officially support Multisite yet, but it should work without issues. Full Multisite support is planned for a future release.

How do I stop Safari on Mac from unzipping downloaded .zip files?

Safari unzips downloaded .zip files automatically, but WordPress needs the plugin as a .zip file. To turn this off:

  1. Open Safari.
  2. Open Settings (Preferences).
  3. On the General tab, uncheck “Open ‘safe’ files after downloading”.

Does this plugin work with caching plugins?

Yes. Visits are recorded by a small script in the browser, so cached pages are counted too.

If you use a caching plugin, clear your website cache after installing or updating.

PHP 7 Support?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with PHP 7.x and PHP 8.x. If you run into any issues, please report them.

IPv6 Support?

Yes. IPv6 addresses are supported as long as PHP on your server was built with IPv6 support.
sections.changelog:
8.18

  1. Stronger bot filtering: crawlers and automated browsers that run JavaScript but do not call themselves “bot” (GoogleOther, Google-InspectionTool, Chrome-Lighthouse, HeadlessChrome, Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium, uptime monitors, HTTP libraries, AI crawlers…) are no longer counted as visitors. The real request User-Agent is checked as well as the one reported by the page, and automated browsers (navigator.webdriver) are ignored. Real visitors on CUBOT phones are counted again.
  2. Pages prerendered by the browser are only counted when the visitor actually opens them. Chrome prerenders top Google results, which was inflating “search engine visits”.
  3. Accurate time on site: engaged time is now measured in the browser (visible tab + recent interaction) and reported per page view. It replaces the Heartbeat-based duration, which kept counting for idle/background tabs and measured the first-to-last request of an IP over the whole day. Single-page visits are now part of the average. Visits recorded before 8.18 show “-” instead of an invented value.
  4. Clearer traffic sources: each visit is counted once, under the source of its first page. Google visits now appear under Organic Search (they were listed as a “google.com” referral), and Gmail, Google Docs, Translate and similar links are no longer counted as search engine visits.
  5. More accurate countries: the visitor IP is taken from Cloudflare/CDN headers first, internal proxy addresses are skipped, “IP:port” values are understood, and Cloudflare’s country takes priority. The location cache now expires (30 days, 1 day for unknown).
  6. Visitors whose IP cannot be determined are no longer counted as a new visitor on every page view.
  7. Performance: database schema checks (including two ALTER TABLE statements) no longer run on every request, only once after an update. The front end no longer loads jQuery and WordPress Heartbeat for visitors, and the visitor IP is no longer printed into the page HTML (which page-cache plugins could serve to other visitors).
  8. Removed the fake “First Visit” hit recorded on installation.
  9. Refreshed dashboard design: new header with the site-time clock, colored stat boxes with 7-day sparklines, Traffic Report with range buttons and visitor columns + page-view line, a single “Browsers & Search Engines” card with ranked bars (replaces the two pie charts and no longer loads Google Charts), and a clearer layout that works on phones.
  10. New “Visitors by Country” map: countries shaded by their number of visitors, with a Today / 7 days / 30 days / All time switcher. Borders ship with the plugin, so the map no longer loads map tiles from an external server. The ranked top-countries list beside it is a Pro preview.
  11. New Summary Statistics layout: traffic per period with the change vs. yesterday and new vs. returning visitors (last 30 days).
  12. Fix: “Last 7 Days”, “Last 30 Days” and “This Year” in Summary Statistics counted one extra day; they now match the Traffic Report.
  13. Cards no longer stretch to the height of the card next to them, so there is no empty space under short tables.
  14. “Visits Time Graph” is now “Visits by Hour”: one compact 24-hour chart with the busiest hour and the current hour highlighted, instead of a paged table (date search and Excel export are kept).
  15. Faster Traffic Report and Summary Statistics: date filters now use the database index instead of scanning every visit, plus a new covering index; “All time” caches past months. Fixes: “All time” showed a single month when the history spanned whole years, and “30 days” / “Last month” showed one day too many.
  16. Recent visitors: cleaner rows (country in bold with the city, readable color-coded time on site such as “2 min 5 sec”), and a row now expands inline instead of opening a popup.
  17. The “Online Users” box now shows the live number of visitors online (refreshed every 30 seconds). The list of who is online remains a Pro feature.
  18. Fix: “Today vs. yesterday” badges compared today-so-far with the whole of yesterday, so they showed a decrease for most of the day. They now compare with yesterday up to the same time.
  19. “Traffic by Title” redesigned: ranked rows with a share bar, and clicking a page expands it inline instead of opening a popup.
  20. New, cleaner upgrade window that explains what PRO adds; it appears at most once per session and “Don’t show again” turns it off.
  21. “Latest Search Keywords” is now “Search Traffic”, with three tabs: the pages search-engine visitors land on, what visitors type into your site’s own search box (including searches that found nothing), and a preview of Google search keywords from Search Console (coming to PRO). Google and Bing no longer share search keywords with any analytics plugin, so the old keywords list was almost always empty.
  22. Uninstall: when “Delete plugin data on uninstall” is enabled, the online-users and daily-stats tables and the database version markers are now removed too, so a later re-install sets up the database correctly.
  23. Redesigned Settings page: sections as cards with a side menu, on/off switches, the geolocation database status at a glance, a separate danger zone for data deletion (with a confirmation) and a save bar that stays in view. Fix: the last excluded user role could not be removed, and saving an empty access list caused a PHP warning.
  24. Redesigned Help page: quick links (FAQ, support, review), every shortcode with a copy button, a table of all [ahc_stats_widget] options with an example, and answers to common questions. Fix: in [ahc_stats_widget], display_total_visitors=false also hid the total page views.
  25. Shortcodes and the “Visitor Traffic” widget: consistent “Label: value” rows, no empty heading or invalid style when no title/font is set. The widget now uses the theme’s widget wrapper and title style, its settings are sanitized when saved, and a stray backslash was removed from its settings form labels. All shortcode numbers were checked against the database (today, yesterday and total).
  26. English review of every label, notice and message: clearer box and panel titles (“Search Engine Visits”, “Today’s Traffic by Country”), consistent “vs. same time yesterday”, fixed typos and punctuation, an up-to-date message on the Plugins page and a rewritten upgrade banner. The plugin description and FAQ were updated to match the features of this version.
  27. Better first run: until the first visit is recorded, the dashboard shows a short “Tracking is on” guide (see your first visit, exclude your own visits, add a shortcode). The “vs. yesterday” badges show a neutral dash when there is nothing to compare and “New” when yesterday had no visits, instead of a misleading green “0%”. Empty tables say “No visitors recorded yet” instead of “No data available”.

8.17

  1. Security hardening (follow-up to the 8.16 X-Real-IP XSS fix): visitor data in the dashboard (IP, country, city, region, browser, page titles) is now escaped with entity double-encoding, so values stored by older versions can no longer be decoded back into HTML. Invalid IP values left in the database by older versions are cleaned up automatically on update.
  2. Security hardening: the dashboard’s HTML-to-text helper now uses an inert parser instead of innerHTML, and the IP filter in the Recent Visitors search is escaped before being used in the database query.

8.16

  1. Security fix: resolved an unauthenticated stored DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the ‘X-Real-IP’ (and other forwarded-IP) HTTP headers. The visitor IP is now strictly validated as a real IPv4/IPv6 address before it is stored, and all visitor data shown in the IP details popup is escaped before being added to the page.
  2. Visitor map now shows place names in English for all countries (switched to Esri World Street Map tiles, no API key required).

8.15

  1. Fix: the visitor map on the dashboard showed “API KEY REQUIRED” placeholder tiles instead of the map, because the CARTO basemap service now requires an API key. The map now uses OpenStreetMap tiles, which work without any key.

8.14

  1. Critical fix: on sites running PHP older than 8.1, the tracking request (admin-ajax.php) crashed with a fatal error, so no visits were recorded at all. The bundled geolocation library requires PHP 8.1+; it is now loaded only when the server supports it. On older PHP, visitor country is resolved from the Cloudflare header (if the site is behind Cloudflare) or from a lightweight external lookup, with the result cached to keep tracking fast. Visit recording works on all supported PHP versions again.

8.13

  1. Fix: visitor tracking script (front.js) no longer depends on jQuery, so it loads and records visits even on sites that defer or remove jQuery via performance/optimization plugins. This resolves cases where statistics were not being recorded on some sites.

8.12

  1. Security fix: resolved a reflected XSS vulnerability in the Traffic Sources date filter (from_dt / to_dt) on the statistics page; these values are now properly escaped with esc_attr() before output

8.11

  1. Fixed visitor tracking sometimes failing with a 400 (Bad Request) error on pages whose title or referrer contained special characters; all tracking values are now properly URL-encoded
  2. Front-end tracking script is now versioned so browsers always load the latest version after an update
  3. Visitor map now stretches to fill the space next to the statistics panel, removing the empty gap below it
  4. Side-by-side dashboard panels now share the same height, removing uneven gaps below shorter panels (including the visitors list next to the country panel)

description:
Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics for WordPress

Unlock powerful insights into your website traffic with Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics, the WordPress plugin for tracking visitors, page views, countries, browsers and more — all in one intuitive dashboard.

With real-time data and easy-to-use shortcodes, you’ll get a complete picture of your site’s performance without the complexity. Whether you’re a blogger, business owner, or marketer, this plugin gives you the tools to understand your audience better and make smarter decisions.

Why Choose Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics?

  • Real-Time Visitor Tracking: See how many people are on your site right now and how your traffic changes through the day.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard: All your key insights are displayed on a single, easy-to-navigate dashboard.
  • Comprehensive Analytics: Track visitors by country, browser, referrer, page and hour of the day.
  • Shortcode Integration: Display visitor stats anywhere on your site with simple shortcodes.
  • SEO Insights: See which search engines send visitors, the pages they land on, and what visitors search for on your site.
  • Accurate Numbers: Bots and crawlers are filtered out, and time on site only counts while the visitor is actually reading.

Available Shortcodes (Simple & Flexible)

Add these shortcodes to any post, page, or widget to showcase your traffic stats:

  • [ahc_stats_widget] – Display a site-wide statistics widget on the front end.
  • [ahc_stats_widget title="Your Title" fontsize="16" display_today_visitors=true display_total_visitors=true] – Customize the widget with your own parameters.
  • [ahc_today_visitors] – Display today’s visitors.
  • [ahc_today_visits] – Display today’s page views.
  • [ahc_total_visitors] – Show your all-time visitor count.
  • [ahc_total_visits] – Display total page views.
  • [ahc_yesterday_total_visitors] and [ahc_yesterday_total_visits] – Display yesterday’s visitors and page views.

Free Version Features:

  • Live count of visitors online and today’s traffic compared with yesterday.
  • Traffic report with daily and monthly trends.
  • Visitors by country on an interactive world map.
  • Browsers, search engines, top referring sites and top pages.
  • Visits by hour of the day.
  • Search traffic: the pages search visitors land on and your site’s own search terms.
  • Shortcodes and a widget to display key stats on your site.

Upgrade to Pro for Even More Power!

Take your analytics to the next level with Visitor Traffic Real-Time Statistics Pro:

  • Live Visitors: See who is online right now, where they are and which page they are reading.
